race.comment: The Waller camp has a stranglehold on this contest. KOKATAHI (3) is ready to go one better after two narrow misses to kick off the prep. He has won at this distance, draws to get a suitable run and finds a BM65 that looks well within his reach with Maloney taking over. Her stablemate MAQUISA (15) profiles similarly with two close recent placings. The form around her is red-hot and from the close draw she just needs to hold her form to be right there again. And the third Waller runner, engaged EGMONT (19), also holds genuine appeal. He was a smart debut winner on the Poly and warmed nicely here late last start. Has genuine upside. YES DONALD YES (5) is ticking along nicely, though could find himself in a tricky spot from the draw and be left with too much to do in the straight. ROCK THEM JOOLS (7) has mixed his form but is a chance to fill the drum.
